interview.name: Quinn
interview.answer: The repair drive time and place aren’t specified in these notes.

reflections: Quinn is the organizer who keeps the repair drive moving and shares concrete next steps.
Oren is cooperative but forgetful, and he responds well to a direct reminder plus a written list.
Rey is engaged and willing to review details once invited, suggesting Quinn is coordinating multiple helpers.
Quinn is the main organizer and communicator for the repair drive, keeping others informed and offering to send details.
Oren is willing to help with repairs but needs reminders and clarification about the task list.
Rey is responsive and willing to review the details, then contribute where help is needed.
Quinn is the main coordinator here, repeatedly offering to send the repair-drive details and clarify what is still needed.
Oren and Rey are responsive and cooperative, asking for the list and indicating they will review it or help where they can.
The interaction is practical and follow-up oriented, with participants coordinating around errands, reminders, and next steps rather than debating the plan.
Quinn is the consistent coordinator who shares repair details and follows through on sending specifics.
Rey and Ira respond cooperatively and seem willing to review the list and help where needed.
Dane is ready to take on concrete tasks, and the group is moving from general coordination to assigning parts of the repair work.
Quinn is the central coordinator, keeping people updated with the repair-drive details and helping each person know what still needs doing.
Dane is willing to jump in on concrete tasks and seems comfortable taking direction on the repair list.
Pia and Hana are coordinating around logistics and tools, showing they want clear timing and assignment details before committing.
